folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: full feature map and amendments, 2026-11-04 (B362)
folds.body:
The full394-line coverage map retains nine distinct finite mechanisms: conserved object variants with loans/wear/refit; mature methods and fixed two-opponent native battle; willing funded residents and mixed work itineraries; Tidemark’s separate native owners; eight Backlog proof families; current cost/blocker/account legibility; pinned Ink cursor/host consequence publication; selective repository absorption; and earned continued personal life. Source/native/UI/save consumer lists and allListedSourceContentBundled do not establish their gameplay or atomicity. Every row still states implemented-unverified, and the later owner pointer above supersedes this older scope as current project status.

Preserve real agency and costs within those mechanisms: borrowed custody is not copied ownership, a report is not private NPC state, a mission offer/acceptance/outcome is not actual extraction/hub arrival/settlement, and an earned personal passage is not another mission or free stock grant. The map’s once-only job/demand/funds receipts and return/cancellation semantics need their actual consumers. Existing household/native support can matter without universally forcing chores, errors or balancing taxes on stronger means. A mere UI account or Ink response is not a durable reward unless the same guarded candidate successfully commits.

The repository9adopted/15already-covered/4not-applicable/2rejected total30; these are dispositions, not30built mechanics. Nineteen source profiles are not nineteen native worlds. Nested3chains/62commands split53player/9NPC; registry/control/site/person/phase totals describe this defined scope rather than equal gameplay depth. Qualified early-service source frame, original residence/credit/method choices and retained old Ink content remain separate from full source-world parity. The17continued-life commands and three personal controls preserve finite actual workers/output consumers without duplicating reward, time or custody owners.

Expansion5/6/7/8, battle1/2/3, Backlog1/2 and Ink wrapper/content versions answer different compatibility questions. Explicit choice/enrollment differs from absent defaults; an older reader’s deliberate rejection differs from silent stranding or lossless support. Local calendars advance under actual admitted presence/clock contracts, not arbitrary global time or free off-screen production. Existing one-prestige implementation scope is historical, not the later retired product gate. No source/readback/build claim was refreshed, no linked source matrix or profile body was credited as read, and no runtime, save, UI/browser or current integration was verified by this reconciliation.
